title: Evidence-based element change detection and trusted locator memory
criteriaSource: Phase 14 brief, section 7 (REQUIRED ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA), 70 criteria in 12 sections
purpose: The 70 criteria were stated in the phase brief and nowhere in the repository.
Nothing could therefore check whether a criterion had an implementation or a test,
and AC-18 turned out to have neither: evidence was captured after the interaction,
so a click that navigated recorded a trusted fact about an element on the landing
page. This file is the register that absence allowed to go unnoticed.
tests/regression/p14-traceability.check.cjs asserts every row below resolves to a
file that exists and a test that is really present, so a criterion cannot silently

verifiedByMeaning.test: An executing regression test asserts the criterion. The named tests must exist.
verifiedByMeaning.platform: The behaviour belongs to a third party, not to Falcon's code or config. Asserting it would assert someone else's platform semantics.
verifiedByMeaning.review: A process criterion about the phase itself, evidenced by a recorded review verdict rather than by code.

criteria.text: Unapproved state cannot become trusted through cache restoration.

AC-56 negative control: the SAME check catches data/locator_memory.json the moment it is added to a scratch copy of the restore list (proves the gate can fail)

criteria.text: Cache failure cannot hide test results.
criteria.justification: This is a property of GitHub Actions' own restore-step semantics — a failed restore does not fail the job — not of anything Falcon's code or configuration decides. A test asserting it would be asserting a third party's platform behaviour, which is a worse gap than an honest omission. The reasoning is recorded alongside the cache-policy gates in tests/regression/p14-traceability.check.cjs.

criteria.text: Cross-run restoration is demonstrated on a later hosted run if claimed.
criteria.justification: Conditional on a claim this phase deliberately does not make. Locator memory is excluded from the CI cache entirely (AC-56), so there is no cross-run restoration to demonstrate. The gate that keeps it excluded is what keeps this criterion satisfied; if the store is ever cached, this becomes a live requirement.

tests.name: AC-56: data/locator_memory.json (Phase 14's evidence-based store) appears in NEITHER the restore nor the save cache path list
